rules.decriminalized: Conviction before decriminalization; written request to convicting court; court notifies prosecutor; written objection within 10 judicial days after receipt; no submission fee under NRS 179.271(2); traffic offenses excluded. An objection requires a hearing. No objection requires grant. At hearing, prosecutor must establish good cause not to grant by clear and convincing evidence.
rules.pardon: Automatic sealing follows court and Repository receipt of certified unconditional pardon. Written petition with proof of pardon is separately authorized. NRS 179.273(3) excludes prosecutorial and criminal-justice-agency review. Court grants unless listed charges differ from pardon. NRS 179.273(5) bars a court or criminal-justice-agency submission fee.

supersedesOnly: Inherited prosecutor-first, prosecutor-stipulation, ordinary 30-day notice and filing-fee assertions for these two special routes in the older reference records and composed family SPEC. Other routes and live runtime authority are unchanged.
implementation: Request/petition, route-specific captions, component set, guides, routing table and fee/service statements move together; remove mandatory prosecutor stipulation from these two routes; retain real proof-of-pardon and decriminalization record requirements.
remainingReview: Exact corrected outputs, local instrument practice, source-to-runtime synchronization and independent review remain required. The unconditional-pardon product scope is not expanded to conditional pardons.
